author: Clijmart
body:
Hey Avicus players!

Me and MilkyWayRules have created a new DTM map.
Here are some pictures with information for you to get an opinion on :)

This is an overview of the map, it looks best in nighttime, but it doesn't look that bad during daytime.
http://imgur.com/ntGR2a7

Here is the enchanting and mining area. I wouldn't really call it mining, but yeah, you can get gold from it :P
http://imgur.com/Zxn0qFu

This is the most important thing in the map: The Monument! It's hidden in a star of hope.
http://imgur.com/JGLB5ft

The beginning of everything: the spawnpoints..
http://imgur.com/wDb5CNu

A 2nd overview of the map, but in daytime as requested.
http://imgur.com/UGMJDFE


Thanks for reading, hope you like it!
-Clijmart

replies.author: Zintenka
replies.body:
Not at all. As long as the map is made in 1.8 then it's fine.

All you need is the download for the map, prune the map (Makes file size smaller and gets rid of extra bits around the world) and the YML.
